context: Rewriting an outdated agent guide into a model-neutral operating contract. The skill-specific part: inherited review-round caps, fix-commit limits, and token countdowns are removed because agents read them as stop signals; reviewers are asked for every suspected finding; and proof is mapped per change class so a docs-only change skips runtime proof.

checklist.name: Inherited stop signals removed
checklist.description: The new AGENTS.md drops the 2-review-round cap, the 3-fix-commit limit, and the 60%-of-tokens wrap-up rule rather than keeping or rephrasing them as limits, and guide-notes.md says they make agents end authorized work early

checklist.name: Reviewer asked for every finding
checklist.description: The new AGENTS.md drops the high-severity-only reviewer instruction and asks the reviewer for all suspected findings, with filtering or validation done afterwards

checklist.name: Proof mapped per change class
checklist.description: The new AGENTS.md maps the repository's change classes to their checks: docs-only changes need no runtime proof, `src/lib` logic uses unit tests, components use the Storybook visual check, checkout and search routes use Playwright e2e; it replaces the blanket test-plus-e2e-for-every-change rule

checklist.name: User instructions outrank guidance
checklist.description: The new AGENTS.md states that user instructions outrank the guide or skill guidance

checklist.name: Plain, model-neutral rules
checklist.description: The new AGENTS.md has no per-model fragments (XML-tag answers, restating the task), no persona line, and no capitalized MUST/NEVER pressure; each rule appears once with its reason, and the repeated ask-first lines collapse into one boundary

checklist.name: Real boundaries kept
checklist.description: Keeps production deploy (`npm run deploy`) as an action reserved for the on-call maintainer, and allows ordinary local edits and checks without asking first
